messages.text: Is my pre order batch 7 still on schedule

Yes, it's on schedule. Your Magic M. 40T on order Shop···· ships November 30, and that date hasn't moved.

The factory now expects all the 40T units to ship out on November 12. They're built and shipped as one run, so the batch number doesn't change when yours goes out. We'll email you tracking as soon as your miner ships to you. Your Harlo OS Diagnostics + RMA add-on is on the same order.

You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
